baselines.baseline_prediction_scope: Squared losses of stored baseline predictions evaluated exactly; no claim of enclosing ideal-real training algorithms

hist_gradient_boosting.fit_rows: All eligible training inputs/labels; MinMax01 scaling fitted on training inputs only

training_mean.forecast: Exact mean of eligible training targets

certificate.block_rule: Consecutive disjoint eligible rows in chronological order, last block may be smaller
certificate.lower_aggregation: Sum retained disjoint-block dual SSE lower bounds divided by total cohort rows
certificate.unfinished: Retain valid final primal/dual witnesses and report unresolved gap; no favorable replacement or outcome-driven refit
certificate.upper_aggregation: Minimum certified loss upper endpoint of the two actual common frozen training-only heads on the entire cohort

class.class_definition: All [0,1]-valued 2-Lipschitz decoders of each frozen representation
class.metric: Euclidean metric on stored training-normalized features
class.metric_scale_fit: Training-only reciprocal median positive Euclidean distance over32 temporal-stratum probes, fallback1
class.range_only_floor: mean squared distance of unchanged targets to [0,1]; combine with dual lower by max, never addition

data.boundary_history: Past observations from preceding years may be used; test histories may include earlier test-year observations available at each origin
data.eligibility: Discard origin if any of its24 hourly PM lags or its target is absent or NA; no imputation
data.input_order: oldest to newest; origin minus23hours through origin inclusive
data.test_seal: 2014 PM values and missingness are uninterpreted until all models, thresholds, policies and deployment payloads are sealed
data.time_basis: Dataset-recorded calendar timestamps, without timezone conversion

execution.deadline_action: Stop and preserve partial results/failure; do not silently rerun the primary

affine.membership: Exact radial coefficient contraction to norm<=2, using80bit upward norm enclosure; intercept recentered at exact stored-feature training means
affine.objective: mean squared error plus lambda*coefficient squared norm; unpenalized intercept
affine.prediction: Exact rational affine formula followed by clipping to [0,1]
affine.solver: numpy.linalg.solve on centered normal equations with n*lambda diagonal

extension32.anchor_rule: floor((2*j+1)*n_train/(2*32)) for j=0,...,31; training-label-independent and shared across maps
extension32.fit: Conservative pairwise Lipschitz QP with distance lower endpoints and range-aware dual
extension32.prediction: Clipped mean of McShane lower/upper envelopes; exact outward80bit distance arithmetic

policy.abstention: No candidate in the finite panel has a verified achieved upper <=epsilon
policy.control_accuracy: Ordinary minimum decision MSE upper endpoint among all36 heads; ties payload then lexicalID
policy.control_same_rule: Exhaustive same36-head threshold/cost selector with no class screening
policy.cost: Byte length of full independently serialized representation pickle plus canonical deployed-head JSON, including exact coefficients/anchors and metadata but excluding audit witnesses, shared code/runtime and fit data
policy.eligibility: Achieved decision MSE upper endpoint <= epsilon
policy.epsilon_recipe: 19/20 times exact normalized training persistence MSE
policy.fit_order: All class screens first; all unexcluded heads next; freeze screened choice; shadow-fit excluded heads for exhaustive comparison; seal every model and choice before test parsing
policy.screen: Exclude class iff its decision-risk lower bound is strictly greater than epsilon
policy.soundness_goal: Screened and exhaustive same-rule candidate IDs or abstentions must agree
policy.target: Finite-panel tolerance/cost selection on the decision cohort
policy.utility_goal: Positive avoided decoder fit-plus-decision-evaluation time minus added decision-class certification time, with strict stage-accounting qualification

primary_question: Does exact class screening preserve the exhaustive tolerance/cost choice while avoiding enough decoder work to offset its certification overhead?

prior.replay_scope: Step35 imports only pinned generic native source, not previous scientific arrays; prior complete proof archives are referenced rather than recursively copied
prior.step34_conclusion: Manufactured feature-covering anchor repair gained at the boundary but harmed the interior; overall benefit claim excluded

report.significance_claim_condition: Do not claim actionable screening utility if no classes are excluded or added certificate cost exceeds avoided decoder work
report.uncertainty: Exact arithmetic enclosures quantify numerical/class-witness uncertainty only; no iid confidence interval is asserted for dependent time-series rows

scientific_scope.data_newness_claim: New to the retained study record; UCI Appliances was already evaluated in Step24
scientific_scope.stored_features: Operational binary64 coordinates interpreted as exact dyadic numbers

title: Public forecasting pilot of finite-cohort class certificates and safe decoder screening
